tEn: How Granola's Co-Founder Uses AI to Survive Meetings
tZh: Granola 联合创始人如何用 AI 驾驭会议
sEn: Sam, co-founder of Granola, shares how he uses AI meeting briefs, recipes, and agents to stay calm and prepared between back-to-back meetings.
sZh: Granola 联合创始人 Sam 分享他如何用 AI 会议简报、配方和智能体，在连轴转的会议间隙保持从容与准备。

consensus.en: Granola aims to be a calming presence during chaotic back-to-back meetings.
consensus.zh: Granola 旨在成为你连续会议混乱中的平静存在。

consensus.en: Pre-meeting briefs are the most useful feature, saving you from underpreparation.
consensus.zh: 会前简报是最有用的功能，让你免于准备不足。

consensus.en: Meetings hold the most useful and up-to-date company context.
consensus.zh: 会议承载着公司最有用、最新的上下文。

consensus.en: Granola's design principles: calm, hidden transcript, and supporting role.
consensus.zh: Granola 的设计原则：平静、隐藏转录、辅助角色。

consensus.en: Internal agents like Nacho connect to many tools for fast answers.
consensus.zh: 像 Nacho 这样的内部智能体连接多种工具以快速提供答案。

consensus.en: Anyone can ship code, but design systems and components maintain quality.
consensus.zh: 任何人都能发布代码，但设计系统和组件维持质量。

contrarian.en: Hiding the transcript is a deliberate trade-off, despite user complaints.
contrarian.zh: 尽管用户抱怨，隐藏转录是有意为之的权衡。

contrarian.en: Work-life balance improves work quality, contrary to 996 culture.
contrarian.zh: 工作与生活的平衡提高工作质量，与 996 文化相反。

contrarian.en: The hard part is knowing what to build, not just building fast.
contrarian.zh: 难的是知道要构建什么，而不仅仅是快速构建。

contrarian.en: Most people stop too early after shipping version one; sweat the details.
contrarian.zh: 大多数人在发布第一版后就过早停止；要注重细节。

contrarian.en: AI agents are too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment remains key.
contrarian.zh: AI 智能体在头脑风暴时过于顺从；人类判断仍然关键。

contrarian.en: Fighting API/MCP access is futile; embrace external workflows.
contrarian.zh: 抵制 API/MCP 访问是徒劳的；拥抱外部工作流。

turns.en: Hey everyone. Today I'm really excited to welcome Sam, the co-founder of Granola. Granola started as an AI meeting tool and now they're worth 1.5 billion.
